## Plane Crash Info Example
```{r crashes}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Read the page with the encoding fix
crash_url <- "https://planecrashinfo.com/2025/2025.htm"

crash_page <- read_html(
  crash_url,
  encoding = "ISO-8859-1"
)

crash_page

# Extract the table
crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  html_elements("table") |>
  html_table()

# Pull the first table out of the list
crash_df <- crash_tables[[1]]

# Use the first row as the column names
colnames(crash_df) <- crash_df[1, ]

# Remove the first row because it contains column names
crash_df <- crash_df[-1, ]

# Convert Date from character to a Date object
crash_df <- crash_df |>
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date))

head(crash_df)
```

## Salvage Run

```{r game}
page = rvest::read_html(
  "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1"
)

classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements("span.ship-class") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

length(classes)

sum(classes == "Dreadnought")

# Loop

base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"

starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)

pages = vector("list", length(starts))

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(
    paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i])
  )

  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |>
      rvest::html_elements("span.ship-class") |>
      rvest::html_text2(),

    value = pg |>
      rvest::html_elements("span.salvage-value") |>
      rvest::html_text2() |>
      readr::parse_number()
  )

  Sys.sleep(1)
}

registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)

# Check that all 400 wrecks were collected
nrow(registry)

# Keep only Dreadnoughts
dreadnoughts = registry |>
  dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought")

# Check the number of Dreadnoughts
nrow(dreadnoughts)

# Calculate their total estimated salvage
sum(dreadnoughts$value)
```

## Structured Text Extraction

### Course Information

```{r courses}
# Read the ISA course catalog
course_url = "https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/"

course_page = rvest::read_html(course_url)

# Extract the text of the first course, ISA125
isa125_text = course_page |>
  rvest::html_element("div.courseblock") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

isa125_text

# Define the chat object using the same settings as the earlier app
chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna",
  params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)

# Extract the three fields demonstrated in Class 12
course_info = chat$chat_structured(
  isa125_text,
  type = ellmer::type_object(
    name = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The name of the course, without the course code."
    ),
    description = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The description of the course, without the prerequisites."
    ),
    prereqs = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "List the information after the Prerequisites label."
    )
  )
)

# Inspect the extracted information
course_info

# Print the complete prerequisites field
course_info$prereqs
```


## ISA 125 Extraction
```{r ISA 125}
chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna"
)

isa125_courseblock = rvest::read_html("https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/")|>
  rvest::html_elements("#sc_sccoursedescs > div:nth-child(1)")|>
  rvest::html_text2()

chat$chat_structured(
  isa125_courseblock,
  type = ellmer::type_object(
    # code is the name of the first element in the returned sub list
    # type string forces element to be type chr
    code = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The three letter abbreviation for the course and its number. For example ISA 999 or FIN 444"
    ), 
    name = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The title of the course without the three abbreviation and the number. For example Introduction to Macroeconomics. Do not return a period after the name"
    ),
    cr_hr = ellmer::type_integer(description = "The number of credts shown in parantheses after the course code and title")
  )
)
```

# All 150 ISA courses
```{r}
course_vec = rvest::read_html("https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/") |>
  rvest::html_elements(".courseblock") |> rvest::html_text2()

course_list = as.list(course_vec) # make a list 

type_course = ellmer::type_object(
    # code is the name of the first element in the returned sub list
    # type string forces element to be type chr
    code = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The three letter abbreviation for the course and its number. For example ISA 999 or FIN 444"
    ), 
    name = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The title of the course without the three abbreviation and the number. For example Introduction to Macroeconomics. Do not return a period after the name"
    ),
    cr_hr = ellmer::type_integer(description = "The number of credts shown in parantheses after the course code and title")
  )

isa_df = ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(
  chat = chat, prompts = course_list, type = type_course, include_tokens = T, include_cost = T
)

sum(isa_df$cost)
```
